scope: Isolated library-deployment comparison of three already compiled operator probe cases; no model graph, precision or production runtime policy change

arms.name: ddk_baseline
arms.library_policy: Exact original recorded runtime library inventory

arms.name: candidate_without_ddk_hcl
arms.interpretation: Joint library-set and search-path experiment; cannot isolate the causal effect of either individual change

invariants: No compilation or runner rebuild; reuse original hashed contracts, binary, OMC, input, reference and library bytes
Original native manifest/command/result records must agree; missing or changed SHA256 and payload sizes fail preflight
All recorded ELF objects inspected without executing them; retained dependencies, SONAME collisions and duplicate excluded content block candidate
Small verified inputs frozen locally; original and frozen artifact hashes checked before and after each arm
Separate remote root and local report for each arm; verified retrieval precedes default owned-directory cleanup
Existing source artifacts, board system files, shared toolchains and old board weight directories are not modified
Report archives use allowlists and omit binaries, models, raw tensors and shared unfiltered HiLog

host_validation.test_environment: PYTHONPATH=model; shared qwen3.5-py310 interpreter; bytecode/cache disabled; isolated basetemp
host_validation.initial_final_retry: runtime-final.xml recorded collection failure after PYTHONPATH was omitted; corrected invocation passed all 109 tests

elf_sdk_crosscheck.scope: Parser comparison with SDK llvm-readelf on actual local AArch64 ELF files; not user DDK ABI verification

host_validation.independent_review: No blocking findings; retained two-factor comparison and runtime verification limitations

limitations: User supplied textual readelf/strings evidence only; actual user files not available locally
DT_NEEDED analysis does not establish dlopen closure, namespace permissions or firmware ABI compatibility
The runtime comparison does not capture actual platform library mappings or platform-library hashes
Successful Load/Process/numerical comparison alone does not prove the selected backend or NPU execution
No full-model quality, performance or release gate advanced
evidence_root_policy: Validation evidence is relative to the workspace run directory and remains outside the repository
